name: Gautam Gems Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2014, Gautam Gems Ltd deals in the trading, manufacturing, and processing of rough and polished diamonds, along with gold jewellery.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GGL is a Surat-based manufacturer and trader in both rough and polished diamonds. It offers a broad and diverse range of diamonds in various shapes, cuts, sizes, and colours, ranging from 
0.18 carats to over 15 carats, with grading precision tailored to client specifications. The company specialises in rough diamond assorting, cleaving, laser cutting, polishing, and trading of high-quality polished diamonds.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.31 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -24.9% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.93% over last 3 years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 57.9% of their holding.
